basic_profile.bio: I'm Alex, a 24-year-old tech enthusiast from Portland, Oregon. I'm currently working as a junior software developer at a local startup. I have a keen interest in gaming, particularly FPS games like Warzone. In my free time, you'll find me exploring new tech gadgets or dabbling in stock trading apps like Etoro and RobinHood. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings and late at night, especially after work. I'm single and enjoy the flexibility it affords me to focus on my career and hobbies.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in Computer Science and recently started my career in software development. My knowledge primarily comes from university studies, online courses, and a lot of self-experimentation with various tech projects and gaming setups.
